free_tier.stated: 20,000,000 bytes (20 MB) per attachment as the server-enforced default, no paid tier to raise it, and no documented total storage cap.

retention.stated: | Critically different from Discord: attachment URLs are UNSIGNED and permanent

egress.terms: Free and unmetered via cdn.stoatusercontent.com on Cloudflare. CDN responses specify `Cache-Control: public, max-age=2073600`, providing 24 days of edge caching.

tooling: Autumn file service: `POST {autumn}/attachments` with multipart `file` and `X-Bot-Token`/`X-Session-Token`. Documented at stoatchat/stoatchat `docs/docs/developers/api/uploading-files.md`. Bots are first-class; 5 bots per account.
chaining: 100 servers per account x 200 channels per server (from the live `/` limits object) = 20,000 channels, each with unlimited messages. Servers are capped at 100 for existing accounts / 50 for new ones.
limits_note: 20 MB per file; 5 attachments per message; body_limit_size 20,000,000 bytes globally. Live limits object also gives: emojis 500 KB, icons 2.5 MB, banners/backgrounds 6 MB, avatars 4 MB. Those are separate, smaller buckets.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Critically different from Discord: attachment URLs are UNSIGNED and permanent. The platform renamed Revolt->Stoat in Oct 2025 and moved the CDN (autumn.revolt.chat -> cdn.revoltusercontent.com) in May 2025 with 301s still in place; old IDs from the pre-refactor Autumn do 404.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

probe: POST with no auth -> 401 (upload requires a token; read does not)
